d: Short, swept-back platinum white hair with a voluminous, textured style. Narrow, almond-shaped eyes with a smug expression and light pink irises. An adult with a slender, lean build. Wearing a dark purple short-sleeved button-down shirt with a red floral pattern and open chest, paired with tight black leather trousers and polished black pointed dress shoes. Accessories include pink-tinted sunglasses, multiple silver rings on several fingers, layered silver chain bracelets, several ear piercings, and black tattoos on the right forearm and the backs of the hands.
